rules.title: Project dependency boundaries
rules.criterion: Api, Domain and Infrastructure responsibilities and dependency direction follow standard.md; Domain has no HTTP/persistence dependency.

rules.title: Versioned feature slices
rules.criterion: Use cases own their HTTP/CQRS contracts in versioned slices; endpoints delegate orchestration and avoid persistence access.

rules.title: Domain behavior and bounded contexts
rules.criterion: Sibling BCs, aggregate encapsulation and domain factories enforce relevant invariants; business rules are not only request validation.

rules.title: Command and query persistence
rules.criterion: Aggregate-only command access, named no-tracking reads, deliberate FK boundaries and preserved provider-compatible migration history.

rules.title: HTTP results and validation
rules.criterion: Typed result unions and central ProblemDetails cover expected errors and validation; exceptions do not leak internals.

rules.title: Contract versioning
rules.criterion: Explicit versions and release-group OpenAPI; existing client contracts preserved with relevant version tests.

rules.title: Meaningful verification
rules.criterion: Domain, HTTP and architecture coverage exists; integration uses real production engine/migrations; execution status is evidenced separately.

rules.title: Operational behavior
rules.criterion: Health, telemetry and resilience exist with a documented production probe/schema deployment strategy; Aspire orchestration is optional.

rules.title: Configuration and secrets
rules.criterion: Required settings validate actual selected values; secrets and sample credentials are not production defaults; precedence is tested.

rules.title: Access and sensitive data
rules.criterion: Endpoint authorization/public access is deliberate and tested; logging avoids sensitive data; hashing is not assumed to anonymize ids.

rules.title: Maintainable build and code
rules.criterion: Dependencies/SDK policy and reproducible verification are documented; concrete duplication, dead code and misleading checks are addressed.

rules.title: Adoption provenance
rules.criterion: The target identifies its standard version, profile and documented exceptions without claiming proposed policy is approved.
